title: Construction of diassociative bialgebras from antisymmetric infinitesimal bialgebras and related algebra structures
summary: There is a diassociative algebra structure on the tensor product of an associative algebra and a perm algebra. In this paper, we elevate this conclusion to the level of bialgebra.We prove that the tensor product of an antisymmetric infinitesimal bialgebra and a quadratic perm algebra has a diassociative bialgebra structure, and this diassociative bialgebra structure is coboundary (resp. quasi-triangular, triangular, factorizable) if the original antisymmetric infinitesimal bialgebra is coboundary (resp. quasi-triangular,triangular, factorizable).
